Package co.acoustic.mobile.push.sdk.util

Class SystemBarsPadding

java.lang.Object
co.acoustic.mobile.push.sdk.util.SystemBarsPadding
public final class SystemBarsPadding extends Object
Keeps the content of a screen clear of the status bar, the action bar, the navigation bar and display cutouts.

From Android 15, an app that targets API 35 or higher is drawn edge to edge, and from API 36 it cannot opt out. AppCompat does not then place the content below its action bar consistently: 1.6.0 moves it down by the action bar height only, so it starts under the action bar, and 1.7.1 does not move it at all. This class measures where the content frame really is after every layout and pads it by the part that lies under a bar, so it works with whichever AppCompat version the app resolves, and adds nothing where the window already keeps the content clear (before Android 15, or in an app that opts out).

  • Method Details

    • apply

      public static void apply(android.app.Activity activity)
      Pads the activity's content frame so that it stays clear of the system bars and the action bar. Call it once, after setContentView; the padding follows later layouts (the action bar shown or hidden, a new content view, a configuration change the activity handles itself). The layout listener is removed when the window goes away, so a recreated activity (for example after a rotation) does not leave listeners behind.
      Parameters:
      activity - The activity whose content to keep clear
